name: Beef Sirloin
siboNotes: Plain beef sirloin is excellent for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides high-quality protein without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Avoid marinades containing garlic or onion - use garlic-infused oil instead
Grill, broil, or pan-sear for best flavor without adding FODMAPs
Let meat rest 5-10 minutes after cooking for optimal tenderness
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B-vitamins, especially B12
